purityHomeHint: Screen milk for starch or estimate food pH colour
purityStep1: Place a small milk sample on a clean white plate.
purityStep1_dairy: Place a small milk sample on a clean white plate.
purityStep1_other: Prepare a small, evenly mixed food sample on a white background.
purityStep2_dairy: Add 2–3 drops of iodine/Lugol's solution intended for testing.
purityStep2_other: Apply universal indicator exactly as its manufacturer directs.
purityStep3: Wait up to 30 seconds, then photograph it. Do not consume the tested sample.
purityStep3_dairy: Wait up to 30 seconds, then photograph it. Do not consume the tested sample.
purityStep3_other: At the indicator's stated reading time, photograph the treated area in even white light. Do not consume it.
purityDisclaimer: This home screen checks only for a possible starch colour reaction. It cannot confirm overall purity, quality, or safety and is not a laboratory test.
phDisclaimer: This is an approximate universal-indicator colour estimate only. Food colour, lighting, and indicator brand affect it. pH does not establish purity, adulteration, spoilage, edibility, or safety.
purityAlignSample: Place the tested sample inside the circle
purityLightingHint: Use bright, even light for an accurate reading
